body:
Stacked on #14, base `b6ae8025baf1a47e8173997029d2d8b858ada74c`. Exact candidate: `06b67622d9ef9dbcd462478eeaa46d01dc8fe4ad`.

## Scope
Publish five frozen author-provided files under `firmware/transport/**` and `tests/transport/**`, unchanged, plus one bounded native reproduction log. The Russian teaching guide is preserved. No shared protocol, progress, host, or builder files are changed. TX-001 is distinct from the A-005 builder task.

The bounded queue provides ordered partial writes, reserved response/Stop capacity, first-positive-byte sequence and terminal commit, Stop drain handling, HELLO replacement, and fail-closed timeouts. This is a host-tested stack-independent queue boundary, not a USB adapter or complete firmware.

## Reproduced checks
- GCC 14.2.0, C11 with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow`: 13 supplied suites passed.
- ASan + UBSan: the same 13 suites passed with `ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0`; no leak-detection result claimed.
- Host x86-64: `sizeof(mt_tx)=3928`, slot 552 bytes. These are not STM32 map measurements.
- Codec bytes checked against the exact base before testing.
- All six published files read back and matched exact submitted contents.
- Full commands, output, input hashes and limitations: [tests/transport/evidence-native.txt](https://github.com/font-weight/stm32_motortester/blob/06b67622d9ef9dbcd462478eeaa46d01dc8fe4ad/tests/transport/evidence-native.txt).

## Acceptance and remaining work
Requirements: partial software coverage of MVP-F04/F06/F07. Critic-A must independently review this exact SHA under `docs/quality-gate.md`; shared-contract acceptance/integration needs both critics. Reproducing author tests does not grant final acceptance or a score.

No actual USB adapter, descriptors, authorized VID/PID, target ARM/link/map/stack verification, USB/Windows 10/device measurement, ADC/DMA integration, or hardware evidence is supplied here. The guide identifies candidate USB-stack and identifier research as proposals. No merge or readiness level is requested or claimed.
